page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top right. Marginal notes in the right margin, mostly illegible and set in very small type. Small marks in the left margin, probably show-through. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: catio, si initium instituti saevum & impium exceperis. Nam proles recens nata, ut tradit Plutarchus, ex lege deferebatur ad maximè grandaevos suae tribus, (erant autem tribus in urbe Sparta sex;) &, si ea aut detortis vitiosisque membris, aut toto corpore imbecillis ab iis deprehenderetur, velut non usui sed oneri reipublicae futura, loco aspero ad montem Taygetam exponebatur, id est, certae morti dabatur: quod inhumanum plane & barbarum erat. At si vitiorum hujusmodi expertem, & vita dignam iidem illi tribules grandaevi vi[illegible, ~3 letters]derent, reddebant eam parentibus nutriendam. Hi opera solertium & sedularum nutricum[illegible, ~3 letters], membra tenerorum in formam quàm maximè speciosam & venustam effingebant, nec ullis involucris ac fasciis aliorum populorum more fovebant, sed jam tum infantulos adhuc, & mox pueros, habebantque duriuscule, in amictu, cibo, potu, dabantque operam, ne ullis adsuescerent deliciis[illegible, ~2 letters] earumque desiderio caperentur, nec tenebris aut solitudine terrerentur, sed ubique animis, pro aetatis modo, essent intrepidis. Hac ratione apud parentes enutriti, cum jam annum aetatis septimum explessent, non tradebantur mercenariis paedagogis, quod in reliqua

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are very small and mostly unreadable; they are marked as illegible at their positions in the text, with approximate letter counts. Several lines at the foot of the right margin carry further illegible notes, not transcribed. Small marks in the left margin look like show-through or printer's marks and are not transcribed. The catchword "Græ" is partly obscured and is given with [?]. The signature "P 4" is read as a gathering mark. The first line of text is a fragment carried over from the previous page.
